justification: DQ-144 accepts more of the plans' own council-wide wordings, lets a chapter with no land clause inherit its plan's confirmed clause, and decides whole-plan documents Part by Part. Changes a check, not served data.

pre_impl.existing_data: reads data/chapter_scope/chapter_scope_2026-10-11.json; the DQ-144 query reads regulatory_provisions only
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: assumed council-wide plans always say 'all land within the LGA'; most say it another way or inherit the plan's clause
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: extends _COUNCIL_WIDE and _machine_whole_council; adds use_type, inherits_plan, plan_extent and council__chapter#PART keys

functions.name: _machine_whole_council
functions.input: one chapter_scope entry with its applies_to label and quote
functions.output: True only when the entry's own quote proves council-wide land
functions.if_none: False, so the chapter stays counted

values.guard_at: empty quote passes only via inherits_plan with a confirmed plan_source
values.if_missing: the chapter stays counted by DQ-144

queries.purpose: count served rules whose chapter or Part land is undecided
queries.where_clause: served AND reaches every house AND key not in decided chapter keys AND key#part not in decided Part keys

break_it.scenario: a chapter limited to a named centre is worded like a development-type chapter
break_it.what_happens: its rules would stop being counted though they reach every house
break_it.how: _LAND_LIMIT refuses named places, centre/precinct/site/zone words; tested on Lindfield local centre and Hurstville City Centre

break_it.scenario: a mixed chapter has area-specific sections after the first pages
break_it.how: full-PDF scan forced to fire on Sydney Schedules first; Sydney Schedules and Leichhardt C2 reverted; a test pins Schedules

break_it.scenario: a whole-plan document's place Parts are listed as inheriting
break_it.what_happens: Bondi Junction or heritage rules would stop being counted
break_it.how: Waverley B4, B8 and E Parts are never listed; a test asserts it

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a known land-limited sentence is accepted as council-wide, or a pinned mixed chapter or place Part is listed
falsifiable_check.observed_red: the tests caught Lindfield local centre, Hurstville City Centre and Local Government Area cases before any entry relied on them
falsifiable_check.external_authority: each plan's own 'land to which this plan applies' clause, quoted with page

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-144 prints 8,179 and DQ-143 stays 949
